'''Bracil''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] that lived in herds in the [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Klatooine/Legends|Klatooine's]] [[Ferelakk Savannah]]. The creatures were domesticated by Klatooine's [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] [[Klatooinian/Legends|Klatooinians]] and served both as mounts and as one of the primary [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] sources for the savannah's residents.<ref name="LoNH" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bracil were introduced in the [[2015]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying]]'' sourcebook ''[[Lords of Nal Hutta]]'', a part of the ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' [[roleplaying game]] system published by [[Fantasy Flight Games]].<ref name="LoNH" />
